coordinates: PDF points, origin top-left, y grows downward. Underscore run: the run's character box. Drawn rule: the rule's x extent and the 10 pt above it. Cell: the centre lines of its four rules. Tick box: the printed square (ink).
how_measured: pdfplumber characters and drawn lines of the PDF (geom.json); tick squares measured on a 400 dpi render (tick-ink.json); every page looked at at 100 dpi, the form pages again at 170 dpi; overlays looked at.

signing.kind: A subscription agreement and investor questionnaire in one form. The investor completes and signs it; a joint investor signs beside them; a custodian, an adviser representative and the adviser firm sign their own sections where they apply; one acceptance block closes the document.

investor_block.note: two boxed signatures with a date each, on one row: investor, and joint investor or second signer

firm_block.note: the only acceptance block is captioned for a managing dealer, not for the company

who: adviser representative and adviser firm (pages 8 and 10)

signing.individual_and_entity: not separate signature blocks; separated only on page 5: four initials for a natural person, nine for an entity

sure_per_page.2: sure (one judgement: the date-of-birth cell under two captions is one place)
sure_per_page.3: sure of every place; the stamp box is a judgement (a place, a third party's)
sure_per_page.10: sure of every place; whose the acceptance block is, is the open question

the bracket joining the deposit box to its two sub-choices (x 315-323)

the large bold note under it

the rule drawn under each underscore run is the same blank
the footnote rule (y 654) and the two footnotes
